senses.gloss: 1. अक्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. violent [Lat. acer?].

अक्र 2. अ-क्र, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 3. अ and rt. 1.
कृ ?), Ved. inactive, bootless.

अक्र; add — अस्, m. (according to B. R., probably)
a standard, banner; a wall, fence (= प्राकार ac-
cording to Durga on Nirukta VI. 17).

अक्रतु अ-क्रतु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. destitute of will
or energy; powerless, foolish; (Sāy.) without sacrifices.

अक्रम अ-क्रम, अस्, m. want of order,
confusion.

आ-क्रम, अस्, m. coming near, approaching, arriv-
ing, attaining; overcoming, obtaining; invading, at-
tacking, falling upon, an attack; spreading or going
over or upon, surpassing, overloading; might, valour.

अक्रविहस्त अ-क्रवि-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
not having bloody hands; (Sāy.) not having nig-
gardly hands, not close-fisted.

अक्रव्याद अ-क्रव्याद, अस्, आ, अम्, or अ-क्र-
व्याद्, त्, त्, त्, not carnivorous, not eating flesh.

अक्रान्त अ-क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, unpassed, un-
surpassed, unconquered; (आ), f. the Egg plant.

आ-क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, come near; obtained; pos-
sessed; overspread; overcome, overrun; attacked;
surpassed, surmounted; accompanied, attended; agi-
tated or overcome by (any feeling); pained, distressed.
—आक्रान्त-मति, इस्, इस्, इ, mentally overcome or
overpowered; having the mind engrossed or deeply
impressed.
अक्रीडत् अ-क्रीडत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, not playing.

अक्रूर अ-क्रूर, अस्, आ, अम्, not cruel, gentle;
(अस्), m., N. of Kṛṣṇa's paternal uncle and friend.

अक्रोध अ-क्रोध, अस्, m. suppression of
anger, one of the chief virtues among Hindūs; (अस्,
आ, अम्), free from anger.

अ-क्रोधन, अस्, आ, अम्, free from anger; (अस्),
m., N. of a prince, son of Ayutāyu.

आक्रन्द् आ-क्रन्द्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रन्दति, -ते,
-दितुम्, to shout at, roar at; to invoke; to cry with
sorrow, lament, weep: Caus. P. -क्रन्दयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to weep or cry; inspire courage by its sound
(as a drum ?); to shout at, roar at; to cry without
interruption.
आ-क्रन्दन, अम्, n. lamentation, weeping.

आक्रन्दिक, अस्, ई, अम्, going to where cries of
distress are heard.

आ-क्रन्दित, अस्, आ, अम्, roaring, crying wofully;
invoked; (अम्), n. a cry, a roar; lamentation.

आ-क्रन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, shouting at; invoking in a
weeping tone, weeping.

आक्रम् आ-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A., cl. 4. P. -क्रामति,
-क्रमते, -क्राम्यति, -क्रमितुम्, to step near
to; to come towards, approach; to enter; to
visit; arrive at; to step or tread upon, to lie heavily
on, to press; to hold fast with the hands, seize; to
attack, invade, take possession of, become master of,
conquer, overcome; to undertake, begin; to rise,
mount, ascend; to cover: Caus. P. -क्रमयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to come or step near: Desid.
-चिक्रंसते, to wish to ascend.

आ-क्रमण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. coming near, ap-
proaching, stepping upon; (अम्), n. attacking,
marching against, invading; overpowering, subduing;
spreading or extending over or upon; going over or
beyond; attacking.

1. आ-क्रम्य or आ-क्रमणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be
[]
approached; to be attacked; to be ascended or sur-
passed or overcome, to be seized.

2. आ-क्रम्य, ind. having attacked, invaded, seized
upon, overrun or encroached.

आ-क्रान्ति, इस्, f. ascending, rising; stepping upon;
going over or beyond; overpowering; might, valour.
आ-क्रामक, अस्, इका, अम्, an invader, attacker.

आक्री आ-क्री, cl. 9. P. A. -क्रीणाति, -णीते,
-क्रेतुम्, to purchase.

आ-क्रय, अस्, m., Ved. a dealer, small trader,
pedlar.

आक्रीड् आ-क्रीड्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रीडति, -ते,
-डितुम्, to play, sport, take one's pleasure.

आ-क्रीड, अस्, m. a play, sport, pleasure; (अस्, अम्),
m. n. a playing-place, pleasure-grove, garden, royal
garden; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Karutthāma.
आ-क्रीडन, अम्, n. sporting, taking pleasure.
आ-क्रीडिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sporting, playing.

आक्रुश् आ-क्रुश्, cl. 1. P. -क्रोशति, -क्रोष्टुम्,
to cry out at, call out aloud to; to call to any one in
an abusive manner, to assail with angry and menacing
words; to scold at any one; to curse, revile, express
displeasure.
आ-क्रोशक, अस्, ई, अम्, vociferous, abusing, abusive.

आ-क्रोशन, अम्, n. assailing with harsh language,
scolding, censuring; imprecation, curse.

आ-क्रोशनीय or आ-क्रोशितव्य or आ-क्रोश्य, अस्, आ,
अम्, censurable, to be reviled or cursed.
आ-क्रोशित, अस्, आ, अम्, cursed, abused.
आ-क्रोष्टृ, टा, m. a reviler; one who vociferates.
